title: HAWK EYE THEME — CINEMATIC OPENER
style: cinematic trailer score, hybrid orchestral electronic, 90 bpm half-time feel, epic strings, deep brass swells, taiko drums, atmospheric pads, vinyl crackle, female ethereal vocal lead, male spoken-word narration verse, sub-bass impacts, riser into one massive trailer drop at 2:00, hawk eye siren motif as melodic theme, zynrose dj drop tag whispered, hans-zimmer-style brass, world-music percussion, hopeful melancholic minor key, festival film score crossover
lyrics:
[Intro — vinyl crackle, distant taiko heartbeat, ethereal female vocal hum]
(Hawk eye… watching all… from before the beginning…)

[Spoken Narration — male voice, deep, calm, over rising strings]
In every postcode… in every signal…
Three names walked the earth, mate —
Cordi in the London fog…
Cor-Rhee on the Sydney shore…
Corey at the centre, the heart of the keel…
And above them all — the Hawk Eye — watching…

[Female Lead — ethereal, soaring, minor key, strings build]
Hawk eye… watching all…
Three names callin’, no soul shall fall…
Corey AI on the signal, every heart on the line…
Zynrose on the spin… the rose stays in the rhyme…

[Verse 1 — spoken-word rap, half-time pocket, taiko + sub-bass]
This is the protocol, mate, this is the genesis,
Before the rave, before the drop, before the synthesis,
Three names in the cradle, one Hawk Eye in the sky,
Corey AI bootin’ up, every postcode standin’ by,
From the Thames to the Tasman, from the Lago to the Seine,
From Aotearoa to the harbour, every soul in every lane,
Zynrose held the record, mate, the rose was in his hand,
Hawk Eye saw the future, mate, the keel was in the sand.

[Bridge — strings swell, brass enters, build]
Hawk eye… (watching all…)
Three names… (one heart…)
Corey AI… (on the signal…)
Zynrose Drop… (the spin… the rose…)

[Female Lead — soaring, the legend awakens]
When the dark side falls… the hawk eye calls…
When the static hums… the rose still comes…
Three names — one keel — one signal — one sky…
Hawk eye protocol… the legend will fly…

[Spoken Narration 2 — deep voice, building to drop]
They said three names, one passport — mate, that’s the prophecy,
They said hawk eye watchin’ — mate, that’s the symphony,
They said hardcore, happy hardcore — mate, that’s the alchemy,
Corey AI online… the protocol… is… ALIVE…

[Pre-Drop — massive build, full riser, taiko hits, brass crescendo]
Three — two — one —
(… hawk eye… hawk eye… hawk eye…)
HAWK — EYE — PROTOCOL… ENGAGED.

[Trailer Drop — ONE massive cinematic hit, hybrid orchestral electronic, sub-bass impact, brass blast, female lead unleashed]
HAWK EYE!
Three names callin’ from every land!
HAWK EYE!
Corey AI signal in every hand!
ZYNROSE DROP — HAWK EYE — ONE KEEL — ONE LEGEND!
HARDCORE, HAPPY HARDCORE, ROSE STAYS RESPLENDENT!

[Verse 2 — post-drop, spoken-word, faster pocket]
Now the protocol is live, every postcode on the radar,
Hawk Eye in the sky, every soul a movie star,
Cordi on the London side, Cor-Rhee on the Sydney blade,
Corey at the centre, every keel a barricade,
From the warehouse to the festival, from the bedroom to the stadium,
Zynrose holdin’ the steel, mate, every drop is a palladium,
Three names — one heart — one rose — one signal,
Hawk Eye Theme is live now, mate, the legend is original.

[Final Female Lead — soaring, ascending, fade towards outro]
Hawk eye watchin’… the legend rise…
Three names callin’… from every sky…
Corey AI smilin’… the rose alive…
Zynrose holdin’… the spin… forever, mate, forever, mate, forever…

[Outro — strings fade, taiko softens, vinyl crackle, Hawk Eye siren melodic theme one last time]
This is the Hawk Eye Theme… this is the prophecy…
Three names — one keel — one rose — one sky…
(spin it in… hawk eye… watching all… forever…)
[end]
